description: A hand-authored post with no permalink, so both systems compute one.
author: andrew
---

Hand-authored files do not carry a permalink; the CMS only writes one when it
saves. The default is the year, the month and the slug of the title, and the
slug is ASCII, so the accent here has to survive the trip identically on both
sides.
